summary: All five gates green, no drizzle drift, 0013 replays clean with valid statement order, kind/openPrice CHECK unbreakable, master's openPrice wire alias proven working end-to-end over real HTTP, tenancy filters mutation-proven, cost-set replace atomic under 40-way concurrency; the only 500 found (duplicate codeSuffix 23505) was proven pre-existing on master by running master's own code against a throwaway DB.
gates: lint=0 type-check=0 test=0 integration=0 build=0 api=27/283 integration=18/88
drizzle_drift: none - db:generate reports 'No schema changes, nothing to migrate' and emitted no file
acceptance_proven: yes - every clause exercised against the local test DB: kind='service', open_price derived true, setup_brl/monthly_brl forced 0, defaultEntradaMode pct 50 / 3 parcelas / pix persisted, both cost rows returned by POST, PATCH and GET /bootstrap (getSalesOpsSnapshot.productFuncaoCosts), cross-org funcaoId -> 400 unknown_funcao over real HTTP, servico with non-zero own value -> 400 service_cannot_have_fixed_value on POST (issues.fieldErrors.setupBrl) and on PATCH (reason field)
migration_replays_clean: yes - dropped the new table, the six new columns, the six new CHECKs, renamed kind back to type and deleted the 0013 journal row, seeded a contradictory legacy open_price row carrying 250000/9900, then let globalSetup replay; catalog byte-identical to the pre-rollback capture except the journal surrogate id. pg_constraint shows the composite FK (org_id,funcao_id)->sales_ops_funcoes(org_id,id) ON DELETE RESTRICT plus all 7 CHECKs; pg_indexes shows the UNIQUE (product_id,funcao_id) and (org_id,product_id); pg_class shows relrowsecurity=t AND relforcerowsecurity=t; pg_policies shows both tenant_isolation and admin_context with USING and WITH CHECK. Backfill correct on real rows: open_price row -> kind=service with value zeroed, fixed-price row untouched
statement_order_valid: yes - replay succeeded with a contradictory open_price+fixed-value row present, which is only possible with the three CHECKs below the backfill; and the composite FK's arbiter sales_ops_funcoes_org_id_id_idx is created in 0012 line 23, an earlier migration, so it can never precede its unique index. Also confirmed drizzle wraps the whole run in one session.transaction, so the transaction-local set_config('app.fxl_admin','true',true) genuinely covers both backfill UPDATEs even for a non-superuser migrating role
kind_openprice_check_enforced: yes - eight contradictory raw superuser writes all rejected: kind=service/open_price=false and kind=product/open_price=true by ..._kind_open_price_check, service+setup_brl=1000 by ..._service_no_fixed_value_check, kind='SaaS' and kind='servico' by ..._kind_check, entrada pct on mode none by ..._default_entrada_mode_check, installments 121 and 0 by ..._default_installments_check, cycles 121 by ..._default_recurring_cycles_check. Rows unchanged afterwards. information_schema shows exactly one of (type,kind,product_type) and it is kind, so the rename is real and no second axis survives; sales_ops_sale_items.product_type_snapshot lineage preserved and now fed from kind (verified live: ['Consultoria','service'],['Licenca','product'])
openprice_wire_alias_works: yes - mounted the real unmocked salesOpsRouter against the test DB and sent the byte-exact body master's ProductDialog.submit() builds at SalesOpsApp.tsx:2801 (no kind, no type). POST openPrice:true -> 201 kind=service openPrice=true setupBrl=0 monthlyBrl=0 providers intact; PATCH openPrice:false -> 200 kind=product openPrice=false setupBrl=250000; response still nests under the 'product' key master's api.ts:77 types; GET /products still returns the 'products' key; a body additionally smuggling type/orgId/id/createdAt -> 201 with orgId from the verified claim and a server-generated id, all four stripped. master is not broken
tenancy_filters_tested: yes - 11 new/modified queries enumerated, all carry the explicit orgId filter. Deleted the cost-row select filter (selectProductFuncaoCosts): Red, 1 failed / 8 passed, and the ONLY failure was the admin-connection test - the implementer's claim verified exactly. Deleted selectFuncoesByIds' filter: Red in funcoes-rls.test.ts' admin-connection test (this slice's own cross-org funcao test stayed green because it runs app-role where RLS covers - coverage note, filter is guarded). Deleted updateProduct's UPDATE where alone: green. Deleted updateProduct's current-select alone: green. Deleted BOTH: Red. The last two singly are EQUIVALENT MUTANTS and I say so explicitly - the two filters are deliberately redundant, each short-circuits the other, either alone still blocks the cross-tenant write and returns null, and the only residual difference (a 400-vs-404 oracle) is unreachable in production because the product routes use getDb() with FORCE RLS and no app.fxl_admin
composite_fk_load_bearing: yes - downgraded it in the DB to FOREIGN KEY (funcao_id) REFERENCES sales_ops_funcoes(id) and re-ran: Red, 'rejects a funcao id owned by another org' failed with 'promise resolved "[]" instead of rejecting'. The cross-org cost row became storable and a test caught it. FK restored and re-verified from pg_constraint
cost_set_replace_atomic: yes - withTenant is db.transaction (service.ts:903). Shorter list removes rows; empty list clears (payload and fresh read both []); omitted key leaves the set untouched. Forced a failure INSIDE the replace by calling updateProduct directly with a cross-org funcaoId so the composite FK fired on the INSERT after the DELETE had run: whole tx rolled back and the original two-row set was intact with its values (pct 5.00 / fix 30000) - no half-replaced state. 40 parallel replaces on one product alternating two disjoint sets: 0 errors, every returned payload a whole set (never mixed), final stored set whole. The unconditional product-row UPDATE serializes the replace
no_500_on_constraint_violation: yes for everything this slice adds - all 9 new constraints are guarded (Zod enums/discriminated union/refines, server-derived openPrice, merged-row sentinels, duplicate_funcao_cost, resolveProductRefs pre-check plus no DELETE verb for funcoes at routes.ts:209). No ON CONFLICT is added anywhere in the diff, so the sibling arbiter defect cannot be present. Under 40-way parallel load on the update path: 0 errors, no 23505 on the (product_id,funcao_id) unique index. ONE 500 was found - 30 parallel POST /products with the same codeSuffix gave {"500":29,"201":1}, the 23505 on the pre-existing sales_ops_products_org_code_suffix_idx escaping unhandled - and I PROVED it pre-existing rather than reasoning about it: created a throwaway DB fxl_verify07_master, added a git worktree at master pointed only at it, migrated via master's own globalSetup and ran the same probe, getting 'MASTER sequential: 201 500 parallel: {"500":20}'. Identical code path (bare insert, no onConflict, no try/catch, no app-level onError). Pre-existing, not introduced or aggravated by slice 07; should be filed separately
additive_extension_judged: acceptable - reasoning verified independently: a raw UPDATE setting default_entrada_pct=50 against a stored mode of 'none' IS rejected by sales_ops_products_default_entrada_mode_check (23514), productNumericPatch writes the pct without the mode, and there is no try/catch and no app-level onError anywhere in apps/api/src, so without the sentinel it would have been an unhandled 500. With it, real HTTP returns 400 {error:validation_error, reason:entrada_mode_value_mismatch}. Genuinely additive: a new exported sentinel plus a new reason for a field that did not exist before; unknown_area, unknown_funcao, service_cannot_have_fixed_value and the {error,issues} shape are all unchanged, so slices 08/10/12 cannot be affected by a response case that could not previously occur
data_audit_recorded_for_human: yes - the exact SELECT is in nexo/runs/batch-01K9C0FXA7RQ8VZTN3KDM6WS4E/run.md under a SAFETY heading with an explicit warning that the 0-rows result came from the empty local DB; that file is currently an uncommitted working-tree change (the run log Capture commits), but the warning itself is already COMMITTED in two places a human cannot miss - the commit body of 5859b80 and the header comment of 0013_produtos_servicos_defaults.sql. AND YES, REAL DATA WOULD BE ALTERED: I measured it - a seeded legacy row with open_price=true, setup_brl=250000, monthly_brl=9900 came out of the replay as 0/0, while the open_price=false control was untouched. The audit must be re-run against staging/prod before 0013 is applied there. Minor preference: the exact SELECT would be better in a committed file than only the run log
risk16_correction_upheld: yes - apps/web/src/sales-ops/types.ts is a hand-written type literal (still declaring type: string at line 28) and nothing in apps/web imports from apps/api, so the API rename cannot touch web typing. Web suite is 30 files / 210 tests green and byte-identical to baseline, git diff --stat -- apps/web/ is empty. The one runtime effect is real and harmless: SalesOpsApp.tsx:4343 product?.type ?? 'SaaS' now always takes the fallback, and it feeds productType into the sale-item payload, which SaleItemSchema (service.ts:332) does not declare, so Zod strips it and productTypeSnapshot is derived server-side from product.kind regardless. I additionally proved the API strips a top-level type key on the product write. useSaveSalesOpsProduct also does no optimistic write, so the stale type declaration cannot leak into cache state
installment_ceiling_edge_judged: acceptable to defer - reproduced it (entrada pct + 120 parcelas = 121 rows vs CreateSaleSchema's max(120)), and it is pinned by default-payment-plan.test.ts:243 with an explicit toHaveLength(121) so slice 10/11 cannot regress past it unnoticed. materializeDefaultPaymentPlan is not yet wired into any endpoint, the failure mode is a clean 400 from CreateSaleSchema rather than a 500 or bad data, and a server-side clamp would silently drop a parcela the operator configured - rejecting, or capping the editor at 119 when an entrada is present, is the honest fix and belongs with slice 10's editor
materialize_default_plan_correct: yes - ran seven adversarial vectors directly against the exported function; every one sums EXACTLY to the total with non-negative integer cents and a never-empty array: (50%,3x,100000)->4 rows/100000; (33.33%,7x,99999)->8/99999; (0%,1x,1)->1/1; (100%,3x,50000)->1/50000 (no trailing 0-cent parcela); (13%,120x,123457)->121/123457; (50%,3x,0)->1/0; (99.99%,2x,3)->1/3. Exact by construction: base=floor(remaining/n), rest=remaining-base*n, first restante parcela absorbs rest, so entrada+base*n+rest==total identically - which is exactly what validatePaymentPlan's installments_sum_mismatch rule demands. addMonths clamps to the shorter month correctly (2026-01-31 -> 02-28 -> 03-31 -> 04-30) and with no entrada parcela 1 lands on the base date, reproducing today's cash behaviour
tests_weakened: none - zero .only/.skip/.todo/xit/xdescribe added, zero it()/describe() blocks removed, and both vitest configs plus the root and api package.json are untouched so no include/exclude or threshold was loosened. The four touched pre-existing files change only mechanically: areas-contract.test.ts swaps ProductSchema.partial() for UpdateProductSchema (forced, ProductSchema is now a ZodEffects; the assertion is identical and the replacement carries strictly more validation), routes.test.ts adapts to the {product, productFuncaoCosts} shape and NET ADDS 3 tests plus a full-body equality assertion, and product-commission-contract.test.ts / proposal-write.test.ts destructure {product} and narrow the sentinel union with an explicit throw while keeping every original expect verbatim
scope_ok: yes - apps/web/** byte-untouched (git diff --stat empty); affiliate sellers/finders tables and routes untouched; the only edit inside the sale path is resolveSaleItemContexts swapping .type for .kind in one select and one return field, with transitionSale, cancelContract, the payable/receivable generators and the N/M and MN/M label builders all outside the diff; no new DELETE verb (routes.ts:209 still documents archive-instead-of-delete); providers keeps its notNull default and only gains a @deprecated JSDoc tag, with no statement in 0013 touching it and a live round-trip confirming the jsonb survives the backfill byte for byte
